messages:
sophie: Heads up — new upstream model archive arrived from partner (link in infra drive). We need a quick custody + trust check before we schedule quant experiments.

omar: Got it. Can you drop the S3 manifest and checksum here? I want to validate against our ledger.

sophie: https://drive.redwood/models/partner-x/manifest.json
manifest: s3://partner-x/llm_v1.tar.gz
sha256: 3b7f9c1c9a2d4f8e9b6a2f11d4b8c7ea9b1f2a3d4c5e6f7890abcdef12345678
size: 18.2GB

kat: quick triage — is tokenizer bundled or separate? If separate we need mapping to our registry token format.

sophie: tokenizer included as tokenizers/tokenizer.json, vocabulary v2 (counts look okay). Will add tokenizer_SHA and provenance note to the manifest.

hashchain-bot: PROVENANCE CHECK: registry entry not found. Creating provisional ledger record. tx_id: tx_0x9f3a
hashchain-bot: computed_local_sha256: 3b7f9c1c9a2d4f8e9b6a2f11d4b8c7ea9b1f2a3d4c5e6f7890abcdef12345678 (matches upstream)

devon: nice. Sophie, please add who submitted and the link to the signing key. We require KMS-wrapped keys for any external artifacts.

sophie: submitting signer info now — sent to ks-vault. Signer: partner-x-ops@example.com, signature: MEUCIQD... (pasted in vault notes).

omar: OK ledger tx looks sane. Next: prioritization — we have limited quant slot on Friday. Need run matrix: fp16 baseline, int8 PTQ, int8 QAT? Also measure evals: MMLU subset, rouge on our summarization prompts, and latency p95 at 512/1024 tokens.

kat: Suggest priority order: 1) fp16 smoke to validate outputs; 2) int8 PTQ fallback to reduce cost; 3) QAT only if PTQ induces >3% degrade on our evals.

devon: add operational checks: ensure KV cache key layout matches runtime expectations (we saw one model with transposed cache earlier). Also verify memory footprint after quantization, and run perf baseline on a single A100 and a T4.

sophie: noted. I'll spin the artifact into the staging registry under tag provisional/partner-x-llm_v1 and attach manifest+signer+ks-vault ref.

hashchain-bot: REGISTRY: provisional/partner-x-llm_v1 created. retention: 30d. ACL: eng-ml read, eng-infra write.

omar: For experiments, include a deterministic promptset (20 prompts) per benchmark and a fixed RNG seed for generation. Save outputs and hashes to the ledger so we can diff later.

kat: Also capture tokenizer tokenization differences: run tokenization on 500-sample corpus and diff token counts vs our canonical tokenizers. If mismatch >2% flag for manual review.

devon: Ops note — if quant runs change logits ordering (rare), route requests to fallback hosted variant (fp16) automatically. Will add rollout config in console: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

sophie: I'll do the fp16 smoke now and post results in this thread. ETA ~2h. If anything fails, tag @omar and @devon.

omar: Thanks. One more: add a brief risk note to the manifest: external-license=noncommercial? or commercial? check legal.

sophie: pinging legal. Added license: commercial_eval_only.

hashchain-bot: AUDIT: manifest updated (fields: signer_ref, license, tokenizer_sha). audit_id: audit_2002345678_01

sophie: fp16 smoke completed — outputs look consistent with partner samples, no obvious tokenization drift. Perf p95 @512 tokens on A100 = 38ms, on T4 = 220ms. Saved run artifacts to s3://redwood-staging/tests/2002345678/fp16_smoke.tar.gz

kat: great — proceed to PTQ run tomorrow. Marking priority=high and scheduling in the experiments calendar.

omar: closing the trust checklist for now. Leaving provisional registry entry until we finish PTQ + evals. Thanks all :rocket:
